description: Active international climate summit. Greenwashing scrutiny elevated; sustainability claims are being fact-checked in near real time. Fictional headlines attributed to invented outlets.

items.headline: Summit opens with regulators promising action on unverifiable sustainability claims
Beverage group's 'carbon neutral' label withdrawn after offset audit
Campaigners publish live scorecard rating summit sponsors' green claims
Packaging firm's recycling pledge praised as unusually specific

active_controversies: Offset-based 'carbon neutral' labelling is being actively debunked during the summit
Sponsor green claims are being scored publicly and in real time
Vague sustainability language is drawing more criticism than making no claim at all
